sample_unit: physician reviewer scores of ChatGPT responses (3 scenarios x 8 questions x 6 reviewers)

links.outcome: Understandability (PEMAT) and Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT answers to parental questions
links.effect: PEMAT understandability median 100% (IQR 87.5-100), but Flesch-Kincaid grade level was 8.7. No differences in understandability among scenarios or question types.
links.quote: Responses had high accuracy (median 5.0, [interquartile range (IQR), 4.0-6.0]), empathy (median 5.0, [IQR, 5.0-6.0]), completeness (97% of all questions), and understandability (PEMAT % median 100, [IQR, 87.5-100]; Flesch-Kincaid level 8.7).

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM with a patient-specific assessment and plan to generate individualized answers to family questions

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, completeness, empathy, and understandability of ChatGPT-generated responses to parental questions based on simulated clinical PICU scenarios, rated by physicians, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
